images.caption: This image was produced by the Auditor's Office in Lucas County, Ohio for tax assessment purposes. Associated dates are approximate. Descriptive terms related to this photograph include: Ranch houses

facade.notes: the Lucas County Auditor block card: a tax-assessment photo with the parcel number in frame: a just-finished 1950s minimal-traditional house with a front-gable wing, a picture window and shingle siding, the yard still bare graded mud with a builder's sign and boards; its twin next door
